svg.title: tl-parse turns text into a formula document
svg.desc: The source text G[0,2](p0 -> F[1,1]p1) and a semantic profile, closed, go into parse, which returns a FormulaDocument or a Diagnostic with one of 18 stable codes and a byte span. format_document turns the document into canonical text, G[0,2](p0->F[1,1]p1). Parsing that text again gives the same graph.

g.data-text: Diagnostic: 18 stable codes; byte span, no document
parse: canonical text again to same graph: equal nodes, root: graph (call) (call relation)
canonical text: G[0,2](p0->F[1,1]p1); no whitespace to parse: canonical text again: text (call) (call relation)
FormulaDocument: tl-syntax graph; byte spans to format_document: canonical form; bounded: graph (call) (call relation)
FormulaDocument: tl-syntax graph; byte spans to same graph: equal nodes, root: graph (call) (call relation)
format_document: canonical form; bounded to canonical text: G[0,2](p0->F[1,1]p1); no whitespace: text (call) (call relation)
parse: dialect v1; bounded to Diagnostic: 18 stable codes; byte span, no document: refused (call) (call relation)
parse: dialect v1; bounded to FormulaDocument: tl-syntax graph; byte spans: graph (call) (call relation)
semantic profile: closed to parse: dialect v1; bounded: profile (call) (call relation)
source text: G[0,2](p0 -> F[1,1]p1); corpus/v1 to parse: dialect v1; bounded: text (call) (call relation)
